heroHeading: Be proud of your home again.
heroLede: Interior and exterior painting, done carefully and cleaned up properly. You get the price in writing before we open a can, and your rooms go back together at the end of each day.
servicesLede: Most of our work is inside people's homes, which means the prep and the cleanup matter as much as the paint. We would rather do a small number of things carefully than a long list in a hurry.
aboutHeading: A small crew, working close to home.
aboutLine: At Whitetail Painting Solutions we believe everyone deserves to be proud of their home.
aboutBody: We are a painting company in Juniata County. We stay small on purpose, because the work is better when the same people show up each morning and the owner is on the job.
aboutPoints: The same crew from the first day to the last
Written prices before any work starts
Floors covered, furniture moved back, site swept
Insured — happy to send you the certificate

faq.question: What does painting cost?
faq.answer: It depends on the size of the rooms, the shape the surfaces are in, and how much prep they need. That is why we come look first. You get one written price covering the whole job, and it does not move unless you ask for something we did not talk about.

faq.question: How long will my house be torn up?
faq.answer: A single room is usually a day or two. A whole floor tends to run most of a week. Cabinets take longer than people expect, because the drying time between coats is not something we can rush. We will give you the days along with the price.

faq.question: Do I need to move my furniture?
faq.answer: No. We move what we can and cover the rest. If there is something heavy, fragile, or important to you, tell us and we will work around it or wait for you to handle it yourself.

faq.question: What paint do you use?
faq.answer: Good paint from the regular brands, and which one depends on the room. Kitchens, bathrooms, and trim want something harder than a bedroom ceiling does. If you have a brand you prefer, we will use it.

faq.question: Where do you work?
faq.answer: Juniata County and the rest of Central Pennsylvania, within about an hour of home. If you are a little past that, ask — we may already be working near you.
